# @haowei0520/acp-connector

> **Language**: English | [Chinese](./README.zh-CN.md)

Runs local ACP stdio agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, or any Agent Client
Protocol agent) and connects them to an AgentNexus server over the **single
`/ws/acp` WebSocket**. One connection carries control frames and update
streams alike; there is no separate control or data channel.

Use this package when AgentNexus is deployed on a server, but the ACP agent
must run on a developer workstation, private machine, or another environment
that can access local credentials and project files.

Key capabilities:

| Area | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Transport | One authenticated `/ws/acp` WebSocket per account (`?token=…&boot=…`), auto-reconnect with jittered backoff, ordered frame queueing across reconnects. Repeated server handshake rejections (HTTP 4xx — e.g. a revoked bot token) exhaust a budget (default 10) and stop the retry loop with a `handshake_rejected` dashboard state; network outages and 5xx responses keep retrying forever. |
| Sessions | The backend negotiates continuation with a per-process boot id: sessions that this process cannot answer for are rotated to `session/new`, never loaded stale. |
| MCP tools | One isolated Agent process per resident ACP Session and one stable `agentnexus` MCP registration. Shadow injects the current Task credential at HTTP arrival; no platform token enters the model prompt. |
| Inbound files | Backend supplies attachment references; authorized Core MCP tools read the contents. Connector does not stage downloads. |
| Delegation | Task-bound signed credentials stay in Connector; Core checks the Task and live policy on every call. No activation or renewal API. |
| Operations | Foreground runs and named daemon mode with local logs and status commands. |

## LLM token metering

With `llmUpstreamBaseUrl` configured, each isolated Agent process must use its own
`/llm/session/<opaque-key>` model base URL. The connector rewrites its own shared
`/llm` provider URL inside `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` when creating/restoring the
Session process (requires the default `perSessionMcp=true`). Inline configuration
inherited from the connector environment is supported too; explicit account settings
take precedence. Other provider URLs and credentials are preserved. Custom wrappers
can consume the injected `AGENTNEXUS_LLM_BASE_URL`; external config files and Agents
that ignore these settings are not automatically instrumented.

At HTTP arrival, the proxy snapshots the Session's active task/attempt and Trace.
It never searches prompt text or adopts request headers as turn identity. Shared
`/llm`, unknown/retired endpoints and requests without a matching active prompt still
pass through to the provider, but have no attributed usage or model Span. The
unattributed compatibility path must not be used where complete billing is required.
A delayed request arriving only after a new turn starts on the **same Session** uses
that Session's current turn, matching the Session MCP policy; strict proof of the
remote originating attempt would require Agent-side per-request context support.

The proxy forwards optional `cache_read_input_tokens` and
`cache_creation_input_tokens` fields from provider usage.
Backend schema revision 81 stores them on each `usage_events` record and aggregates
them on the user's `usage_ledger` turn; personal and administrator ledger APIs
return both fields. These versions describe this change, not a published release.

OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions `prompt_tokens` already includes cached input;
`prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` supplies its cache-read subdivision.
Anthropic Messages reports uncached `input_tokens` separately from cache reads
and writes, so the Connector adds those components once to produce total input.
JSON and SSE are supported; initial Anthropic message usage is merged with later
cumulative output usage rather than summed across frames.

An omitted dimension remains unknown (`NULL` in storage), including historical
rows and older Connectors. Explicit zero is preserved. A turn's cache aggregate
is known only when every observed call reports that dimension. Cache counts are
subdivisions, never extra tokens to add on top of total input. Credit calculation
still uses the configured input/output price pair; a separate cache tariff and
reliable recovery of missing usage notifications are outside this change.

## Configuration

```json
{
  "accounts": {
    "opencode-main": {
      "botToken": "agb_xxx",
      "acpUrl": "wss://agentnexus.example.com/ws/acp",
      "agent": {
        "transport": "stdio",
        "command": "opencode",
        "args": ["acp", "--cwd", "/Users/me/project"],
        "cwd": "/Users/me/project",
        "clickTheRequest": { "mode": "ask", "responder": "owner_or_requester" },
        "env": {
          "OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT": "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| Field | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `botToken` | required | Bot credential; rides the WS query token and API calls. |
| `acpUrl` | required | `ws(s)://host/ws/acp`. **`controlUrl`/`dataUrl` (0.1.x) are rejected** — those endpoints never existed server-side. |
| `httpBaseUrl` | derived from `acpUrl` | HTTP base for MCP/delegation/file calls. |
| `mcpUrl` | `${httpBaseUrl}/api/v1/mcp` | Upstream MCP endpoint for the local proxy. |
| `localMcpPort` | `28888` | Local MCP reverse-proxy port (bound to `127.0.0.1`). |
| `llmUpstreamBaseUrl` | unset | Actual provider API base behind `/llm`; unset disables the LLM metering proxy. |
| `maxSessionProcesses` | `capacity`, then `10` | Maximum resident Session processes, also advertised as carrier capacity. The account control process is additional. All-busy capacity fails setup without killing active Tasks. |
| `sessionIdleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Reclaim idle processes; resume/load restores provider conversation state. A pending prompt stays resident during long silence. |
| `agent.requestTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Local preparation fallback (1–3,600,000ms). A Backend per-request budget takes precedence. Covers allocation, initialize, restore and config; disarmed when a prompt is forwarded. |
| `perSessionMcp` | `true` | Advertise a stable Session Shadow endpoint in `session/new`/`session/resume`/`session/load`. |
| `promptKeepaliveMs` | `15000` | Negotiated carrier presence interval; it does not imply model progress. Old backends receive the legacy empty-thought keepalive. `0` disables. |
| `pingIntervalMs` | `15000` | WS ping heartbeat. |
| `handshakeFailureMaxAttempts` | `10` | Consecutive HTTP 4xx handshake rejections tolerated before the connector stops retrying (`handshake_rejected` on the dashboard). `0` retries forever. Resume with the dashboard's 「立即重连」 or a daemon restart after fixing the token. |

```bash
agentnexus-acp-connector --config ./agentnexus-acp.json
```

Connector 0.15.1 advertises `setupTimeoutV1`. Updated Core/Bot carries the saved
Bot **Request timeout** (5–3,600s); when absent it uses
`ACP_SESSION_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (default 120s). Each setup RPC has one budget,
including any hidden cold restore. The local fallback above also bounds discovery
and preparation without a Backend budget. Timeout/cancellation removes queued
work and ignores late responses; it does not undo a mutation already sent or
prove remote termination. Upgrade Core/Bot and Connector together to remove both
old timeout limits. The legacy `promptTimeoutMs` field does not impose a total
deadline in the current carrier runtime; execution deadlines remain explicit.

## Pi preset

`connect --agent pi` uses `@openma/pi-acp` (`openma-pi-acp`). Guided installation
pins version `0.1.8`. Install it with Node.js **22.19 or newer**:

```bash
npm install -g @openma/pi-acp@0.1.8
```

The adapter accepts ACP-injected HTTP and stdio MCP servers per session. The
Connector supplies the AgentNexus endpoint and credentials automatically; no
shared `mcp.json` patch is needed. Legacy SSE is not supported by this preset.

Existing account configs retain their saved command. To migrate, back up the
config, change that account's `agent.command` to `openma-pi-acp` and `agent.args`
to `[]`, then restart its Connector and open a new session. Keep its other
settings. Custom adapters remain available through `--agent-cmd <command>`.

With the pinned adapter installed, run `npm run test:pi` in this package.
`PI_ACP_BIN=/path/to/openma-pi-acp` selects a temporary installation. This opt-in
local contract probe runs the real adapter through the Connector relay, session
pool and MCP proxy with deterministic loopback model/MCP doubles. It checks two
concurrent sessions, tool discovery/calls/receipts, next-task credentials and
absence of a shared `mcp.json`. It uses temporary Pi settings and no external
model account; it does not establish Kubernetes or production acceptance.

## Local operation flow

1. In AgentNexus, create an Agent Bridge bot (系统管理 → Agent 桥接, or
   `POST /api/v1/bots` with a personal access token) and copy the displayed
   config snippet; it already points at `/ws/acp`.
2. Save it as a local JSON file and adjust the `agent` section (command,
   workspace, environment).
3. Start the connector from the machine that runs the agent:

```bash
agentnexus-acp-connector start --config ./agentnexus-acp.json --name opencode-main
```

4. Add the bot to a channel or DM in AgentNexus and send `@opencode-main hello`.

## npm CLI and daemon mode

```bash
npm install -g @haowei0520/acp-connector
agentnexus-acp-connector start --config ./agentnexus-acp.json --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector status --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector logs --name opencode-main --lines 200
agentnexus-acp-connector restart --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector stop --name opencode-main
```

Daemon metadata and logs live under `~/.agentnexus/acp-connector/<name>/`
(override with `--home` or `AGENTNEXUS_ACP_HOME`).

## How a turn flows

1. The first turn opens `session/new`. With negotiated `sessionMcpV1`, later
   live turns use `session/prompt` directly; the private `_meta.agentnexus`
   dispatch context carries the Task credential to Connector only.
2. Each Session owns an Agent process in the original business cwd, one MCP
   registration named `agentnexus`, and one fixed local endpoint
   (`http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp/session/{randomSessionCapability}`). The relay binds
   the new Task before forwarding the standard prompt and removes private meta.
   Shadow captures the credential when an HTTP request arrives and never switches
   that request to a later Task. Requests that arrive only after the next turn
   starts use that turn by accepted policy. No active Task means no tool calls.
3. `session/prompt` arrives with text and attachment references. The relay prepends
   a `[Context: channel_id=…, task_id=…]` directive. Attachment contents are read
   through authorized Core MCP tools; the connector does not stage downloads.
4. Agent `session/update` streams cross as chunks; the terminal
   `agent_message` is rewritten to `agent_message_chunk` for streaming (the
   backend classifies the terminal ACP response as the turn result).
5. `ping` probes are answered locally. Agent-originated
   `session/request_permission` callbacks are routed to the backend with
   worker-scoped IDs and are cancelled locally if the WebSocket is offline.
   Session errors fail the current Task; neither prompts nor tool effects are
   replayed automatically.
   Long silence needs no grant refresh. Task completion/cancellation invalidates calls.
6. Cancels are pure standard ACP: the backend resolves the message to a
   `session/cancel` itself; the relay only remaps session ids in both
   directions. There is no custom cancel frame.

## Migrating to 0.12.0

Drain active Tasks before upgrading the Connector/runtime. Every resident ACP
Session now owns a provider process, rather than sharing the account control
process. Plan memory for up to `maxSessionProcesses` children plus one control
process. New Backend and Connector negotiate `sessionMcpV1`; older backends
retain their setup flow. OpenCode gets a separate `OPENCODE_DB` file per Session
and control process, including when launched through a wrapper. Config/auth and
business cwd remain unchanged; a supplied shared `OPENCODE_DB` is overridden.
These runtime databases live in an account-private temporary directory, retained
for idle restore during the account boot and removed on clean account shutdown.
Known Session bindings are bounded to 4,096; close Sessions or restart the account
to release that metadata. Tool definitions are cached per Session; tool catalogue
changes require a new Session, while Core permissions remain checked on every call.
 Idle eviction restores conversations only when the Agent supports
resume/load; it never replays a failed prompt. Session IDs are opaque virtual IDs
mapped to the original provider ID; Backend must not parse them.

The MCP tool catalogue and server instructions occur once in each model request,
without accumulating earlier Task registrations. Model APIs may still require
schemas on every request and may charge tokens for them; this is not a promise of
one-time billing for an entire conversation. Per-request Task snapshots stay immutable,
so a request already received by Shadow cannot adopt a later Task's authorization. Initialization
401/403 becomes an explicit JSON-RPC authorization error without proxy retries.

Local interoperability check (real OpenCode, loopback model/Core fixtures, no
external model calls; not a Kubernetes E2E): `npm run test:opencode`.
Set `OPENCODE_CONTRACT_COMMAND` to select the OpenCode executable.

## Migrating to 0.11.0

Upgrade Backend/Bot and Connector together. The separate `DelegationClient` API,
`delegationTimeoutMs` option, short activation JWT, and `/delegations/active` and
`/delegations/refresh` endpoints are retired. The signed upstream tool credential
is bound to the Task lifetime; stateful MCP transport and standard ACP stay intact.
A coordinated restart terminates in-flight Tasks; retry them explicitly as new
Tasks. Never rely on automatic takeover or replay during an upgrade.

## Migrating from 0.1.x

- Replace `controlUrl`/`dataUrl` with a single `acpUrl`
  (`wss://host/ws/acp`). Configs carrying the old keys fail fast with a
  pointer to `acpUrl` instead of reconnecting against a 404 forever.
- The local session state file (`statePath`) is gone; the boot id in the WS
  query replaces it.
- `@haowei0520/bridge-client` is retired and no longer a dependency.

## Carrier loss and large tool previews

On WebSocket loss, current Task authority is retired and busy Session children
are stopped. New dispatch waits for actual child exit; an unconfirmed stop
blocks dispatch. Failed Tasks are never replayed. Idle Sessions remain resident;
continuation still uses direct prompt, restoring only a retired Session process.

Tool trace notifications above 64 KiB keep their tool ID/status with an explicit
preview omission notice. The actual MCP result delivered to the Agent is not
truncated. Backend `ACP_MAX_FRAME_BYTES` defaults to 20 MiB and can be configured
independently; it does not change upload or provider input limits.

An upstream MCP 401/403 reports its HTTP status and initialize/dispatch stage.
It is not proof that a Task expired. Do not switch credentials or automatically
retry an operation whose result is unconfirmed.

## Release

Releases are executed manually from the final `develop` commit: bump the
package version in the same change set as its code, merge to `develop`, tag
that commit, then publish the artifacts from the same tree:

```bash
git tag -a agentnexus-acp-connector-v0.2.0 -m "agentnexus-acp-connector v0.2.0"
git push origin agentnexus-acp-connector-v0.2.0
npm publish --access public
# build and push the containerized runtime:
# harbor.epichust.com/ai/agentnexus-opencode-bot:<version>
```

The tag must exactly match `package.json` (`agentnexus-acp-connector-v<version>`).

Core-managed Bot settings are authoritative for `clickTheRequest`. Local config fields and legacy scalar aliases are accepted for compatibility, but do not grant approval or override the Bot Owner’s platform policy. Configure automation in the Bot settings UI; default behavior is to ask the Owner or original requester with current channel access.

# @haowei0520/acp-connector

> **语言**: [English](./README.md) | 中文

在本地运行 ACP stdio Agent（OpenCode、Claude Code 或任意 Agent Client Protocol
Agent），通过**单一 `/ws/acp` WebSocket** 接入 AgentNexus 服务端。控制帧与更新
流共用一条连接，不再有独立的 control/data 通道。

适用于 AgentNexus 部署在服务器上、而 ACP Agent 必须运行在开发者工作站、私有
机器或其他能访问本地凭据与项目文件的环境中的场景。

核心能力：

| 领域 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 传输 | 每账号一条经认证的 `/ws/acp` WebSocket（`?token=…&boot=…`），自动重连（抖动退避），断线期间帧按序排队、重连后补发。服务端连续拒绝握手（HTTP 4xx，如 bot token 失效）达到预算（默认 10 次）后停止重连，状态页显示 `handshake_rejected`；网络故障与 5xx 响应不计入，会一直重试。 |
| 会话 | 后端用进程级 boot id 协商续聊：本进程无法应答的会话轮换为 `session/new`，绝不加载过期会话。 |
| MCP 工具 | 本地反向代理为每个回合提供独立端点（`/mcp/{turnToken}`）；身份来自 URL 而非猜测——无法确定归属的工具调用会被拒绝。 |
| 入站文件 | 后端下发附件引用，由经授权的 Core MCP 工具读取内容；Connector 不再暂存下载。 |
| 委托 | 回合的 delegate token 作为尽力而为的旁路激活/释放；失败只推迟 MCP 可用性，绝不阻塞 ACP 帧。 |
| 运维 | 支持前台运行与命名守护进程模式（本地日志与状态命令）。 |

## 大模型 Token 计量

配置 `llmUpstreamBaseUrl`，并将 Agent 的模型请求路由到 Connector 的 `/llm`
入口后，0.12.4 会随 usage 上报可选的 `cache_read_input_tokens`（缓存读取）和
`cache_creation_input_tokens`（缓存写入）。Backend schema revision 81 将其保存到
每次调用的 `usage_events`，并汇总到用户回合的 `usage_ledger`；个人及管理员账单
API 都返回这两个字段。以上是本次源码版本，不代表已经发布或部署。

OpenAI Chat Completions 的 `prompt_tokens` 已包含缓存输入，其
`prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` 是缓存读取细分；Anthropic Messages 的
`input_tokens` 不包含缓存读写，因此 Connector 将三项相加一次，统一为总输入。
支持 JSON 和 SSE；Anthropic 初始 usage 与后续累计输出合并，不逐帧累加。

历史数据、旧 Connector 或上游未返回的维度保留未知（数据库 `NULL`），明确返回
的 0 保存为 0。只有回合中每条已收到的调用都报告该维度，回合汇总才给出数值。
缓存属于总输入的细分，不再重复叠加。积分仍按配置的输入/输出单价计算；缓存
独立定价及计量通知丢失后的可靠补账不在本次修改范围内。

## 配置

```json
{
  "accounts": {
    "opencode-main": {
      "botToken": "agb_xxx",
      "acpUrl": "wss://agentnexus.example.com/ws/acp",
      "agent": {
        "transport": "stdio",
        "command": "opencode",
        "args": ["acp", "--cwd", "/Users/me/project"],
        "cwd": "/Users/me/project",
        "clickTheRequest": { "mode": "ask", "responder": "owner_or_requester" },
        "env": {
          "OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT": "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `botToken` | 必填 | Bot 凭据；用于 WS query token 与 API 调用。 |
| `acpUrl` | 必填 | `ws(s)://host/ws/acp`。**0.1.x 的 `controlUrl`/`dataUrl` 会被拒绝**——这些端点在服务端从未存在。 |
| `httpBaseUrl` | 由 `acpUrl` 推导 | MCP/委托/文件调用的 HTTP base。 |
| `mcpUrl` | `${httpBaseUrl}/api/v1/mcp` | 本地代理的上游 MCP 端点。 |
| `localMcpPort` | `28888` | 本地 MCP 反向代理端口（只绑 `127.0.0.1`）。 |
| `maxSessionProcesses` | `capacity`，否则 `10` | 常驻 Session 子进程上限，并作为连接并发容量通告；另有一个控制进程。满载时拒绝新建，不杀活动任务。 |
| `sessionIdleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 空闲回收时间；通过 resume/load 恢复原会话，长时间无输出的活动 prompt 不回收。 |
| `agent.requestTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 本地准备超时回退值，范围 1–3,600,000ms；Backend 随请求下发的预算优先。覆盖资源分配、初始化、恢复和配置；prompt 转发后解除。 |
| `perSessionMcp` | `true` | 在 `session/new`/`session/load` 中通告每回合独立 MCP 端点。 |
| `promptKeepaliveMs` | `2000` | 回合流式期间的 agent 思考保活（解除后端流空闲看门狗）。`0` 关闭。 |
| `pingIntervalMs` | `15000` | WS ping 心跳。 |
| `handshakeFailureMaxAttempts` | `10` | 连续 HTTP 4xx 握手被拒的容忍次数，超过后 connector 停止重连（状态页显示 `handshake_rejected`）。`0` 表示永不放弃。修好 token 后用状态页「立即重连」或重启守护进程恢复。 |

```bash
agentnexus-acp-connector --config ./agentnexus-acp.json
```

Connector 0.15.1 通告 `setupTimeoutV1`。配套 Core/Bot 将 Bot 页面保存的
**Request timeout**（5–3,600 秒）传到执行请求；未配置时使用
`ACP_SESSION_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`（默认 120 秒）。每条准备 RPC 的预算包含
内部冷恢复，不在初始化、恢复、配置之间重新计时。无 Backend 预算的发现/准备请求
使用上述本地回退值。过期或取消会移除排队请求并忽略迟到响应；已发出的配置不能据此
宣称撤销，取消也不证明远端执行已停止。消除旧的两层限制需要配套升级 Core/Bot 和
Connector。旧 `promptTimeoutMs` 字段不在当前承载运行时启用总执行期限；执行限时仍需显式配置。

## Pi 默认预设

`connect --agent pi` 使用 `@openma/pi-acp`（命令 `openma-pi-acp`），交互安装固定为
`0.1.8`。需要 **Node.js 22.19 或更高版本**：

```bash
npm install -g @openma/pi-acp@0.1.8
```

此适配器按会话接收 ACP 注入的 HTTP / stdio MCP。Connector 自动提供 AgentNexus
端点和凭据，无需修改共享 `mcp.json`。此预设不支持旧式 SSE。

已有账号保留原来的启动命令。迁移时先备份配置，把对应账号的 `agent.command`
改为 `openma-pi-acp`、`agent.args` 改为 `[]`，保留其他设置，再重启对应 Connector
并新建会话。自定义适配器仍可通过 `--agent-cmd <command>` 接入。

安装固定版本适配器后，可在此包目录运行 `npm run test:pi`，或通过
`PI_ACP_BIN=/path/to/openma-pi-acp` 指向临时安装。此可选本地合同测试使用真实适配器、
Connector relay、会话进程池和 MCP 代理，模型与上游 MCP 为确定性的回环服务。
覆盖双会话并发、工具发现/调用/结果返回、下一任务凭据和无共享 `mcp.json` 写入。
测试使用临时 Pi 配置，无需外部模型账号，不代表 Kubernetes 或生产环境验收。

## 本地接入流程

1. 在 AgentNexus 中创建 Agent Bridge Bot（系统管理 → Agent 桥接，或用个人令牌
   调 `POST /api/v1/bots`），复制页面给出的配置片段；它已指向 `/ws/acp`。
2. 保存为本地 JSON 文件，按需调整 `agent` 部分（命令、工作区、环境变量）。
3. 在运行 Agent 的机器上启动 connector：

```bash
agentnexus-acp-connector start --config ./agentnexus-acp.json --name opencode-main
```

4. 在 AgentNexus 中把 Bot 拉入频道或私聊，发送 `@opencode-main hello`。

## npm CLI 与守护进程

```bash
npm install -g @haowei0520/acp-connector
agentnexus-acp-connector start --config ./agentnexus-acp.json --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector status --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector logs --name opencode-main --lines 200
agentnexus-acp-connector restart --name opencode-main
agentnexus-acp-connector stop --name opencode-main
```

守护进程元数据与日志位于 `~/.agentnexus/acp-connector/<name>/`（可用 `--home`
或 `AGENTNEXUS_ACP_HOME` 覆盖）。

## 一个回合的完整流程

1. 后端发送 `session/new`/`session/load`，`_meta.agentnexus` 携带调度上下文
   （频道、任务、turn token、delegate token）。
2. relay 剥离 `_meta`，通告本回合的本地 MCP 端点
   （`http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp/{turnToken}`），并登记身份。
3. `session/prompt` 到达：文本（当回合已委托授权且 Agent 声明了对应 prompt
   能力时，还带附件引用列表）。relay 预置
   `[Context: channel_id=…, task_id=…]` 指令，把拉取到的附件落盘为
   `resource_link` 块，再转发给 Agent。
4. Agent 的 `session/update` 流按 chunk 透传；终结 `agent_message` 会被改写为
   `agent_message_chunk`（后端把终结 ACP 响应分类为回合结果）。
5. `ping` 探测在本地应答。Agent 发起的 `session/request_permission` 使用
   worker 隔离的 ID 转发到后端；WebSocket 离线时在本地取消。Session 错误结束
   当前 Task，不自动重放 prompt 或工具副作用。
6. 取消全走标准 ACP：后端自行将消息解析为 `session/cancel`，连接器仅做
   session id 双向映射后转发，不再有自定义取消帧。

## 从 0.1.x 迁移

- 把 `controlUrl`/`dataUrl` 换成单一 `acpUrl`（`wss://host/ws/acp`）。携带旧键
  的配置会立即报错并指明改法，而不是对着 404 永久重连。
- 本地会话状态文件（`statePath`）已移除；WS query 中的 boot id 取代之。
- `@haowei0520/bridge-client` 已退役，不再是依赖。

## 发布

发布从 `develop` 最终提交手工执行：包版本随代码同一变更集内升级，合并到
`develop` 后在该提交上打注解 tag，再基于同一棵树发布产物：

```bash
git tag -a agentnexus-acp-connector-v0.2.0 -m "agentnexus-acp-connector v0.2.0"
git push origin agentnexus-acp-connector-v0.2.0
npm publish --access public
# 构建并推送容器化 runtime：
# harbor.epichust.com/ai/agentnexus-opencode-bot:<version>
```

tag 必须与 `package.json` 完全一致（`agentnexus-acp-connector-v<version>`）。

## 升级至 0.12.0

升级前先等待当前任务结束。每个常驻 ACP Session 使用独立 Agent 进程，
保留原业务 cwd；MCP 注册名固定为 `agentnexus`，地址在 Session 生命周期内固定。存活 Session 每轮直接 prompt，不再 resume/load；
Shadow 在收到 HTTP 请求时固定当前 Task 凭据，私有元数据在转给 Agent 前删除。
平台 Token 保存在 Connector，不放入模型提示词。已进入 Shadow 的请求固定旧身份；用户已接受尚未抵达的旧调用按抵达时当前轮次授权。
跨 Session 独立入口与上下文，空闲时拒绝工具调用。

每次模型请求只有一份 MCP 工具定义与说明，不随历史 Task 或其他 Session 累积。
模型 API 仍可能要求每次携带 schema 并计费；不承诺整个会话只计一次 token。
容量默认 10 个 Session 子进程，另有控制进程，需评估内存。空闲进程回收后仅通过
resume/load 恢复会话，不重跑失败任务；Agent 不支持恢复时会明确失败。
初始化 401/403 返回明确鉴权错误，不包装为可重试的普通代理故障。

`npm run test:opencode` 使用真实 OpenCode 和本地模型/Core 替身验证线协议，
不调用外部模型，不代表已通过 Kubernetes/UAT 端到端验收。

OpenCode 的控制进程与各 Session 使用独立 `OPENCODE_DB` 文件，避免首次 WAL 初始化锁竞争；
原业务 cwd、配置及账户凭据目录保留。此运行期覆盖也适用于包装命令，优先于用户提供的
共享 `OPENCODE_DB`。数据库位于账户私有临时目录，空闲恢复保留，正常停止 Connector 后删除。
Session 元数据上限 4,096；工具目录变更需新建 Session，每次调用仍由 Core 检查实时权限。

`clickTheRequest` 以 Core 中由 Bot Owner 管理的设置为准。本地配置与旧标量别名仅兼容读取，不会授予审批权限或覆盖平台策略；需要无人值守时，请在 Bot 设置中明确选择自动策略。默认询问当前有频道访问权的 Owner 或原始任务发起人。
